question: In each league, considering all seasons, which single team has the fewest total match wins based on comparing home and away goals, including teams with zero wins, ensuring that if multiple teams tie for the fewest wins, only one team is returned for each league?
sql:
-- Final query with integer cast for total_wins
WITH league_teams AS (
    SELECT league_id, home_team_api_id as team_api_id FROM Match
    UNION
    SELECT league_id, away_team_api_id as team_api_id FROM Match
),
team_wins AS (
    SELECT league_id, home_team_api_id as team_api_id, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY league_id, home_team_api_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT league_id, away_team_api_id as team_api_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins
    FROM Match
    GROUP BY league_id, away_team_api_id
),
team_totals AS (
    SELECT lt.league_id, lt.team_api_id, COALESCE(SUM(tw.wins), 0) as total_wins
    FROM league_teams lt
    LEFT JOIN team_wins tw ON lt.league_id = tw.league_id AND lt.team_api_id = tw.team_api_id
    GROUP BY lt.league_id, lt.team_api_id
)
SELECT tt.league_id, l.name as league_name, tt.team_api_id, t.team_long_name, CAST(tt.total_wins AS INTEGER) as total_wins
FROM team_totals tt
JOIN League l ON tt.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON tt.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tt.league_id ORDER BY tt.total_wins ASC, tt.team_api_id ASC) = 1
ORDER BY tt.league_id
